body.opens: Drawn in the eleventh session's dialogue and written into Glass: one field of holons, kept by stores, governed by engines: the engine naked, a few offers each a journey (read, subscribe, commit, mount), the field a value it holds, stores subscribed both ways, refusal a value and failure stated at the edge. The way from here, each step leaving the oracle green: pin the bar; the field as plain data; the store tells; commit as a journey; in flight and order; subscribe by what a read touched; the act cut short carried over; compat let go. After: the held field as bytes, workers, buffers, programs.

name: The engine drawn again, and the way from here

body.opens: The format spoken between parts, JSON or bytes; reach for rules that judge more than bodies name; what a subscription tracks; the field as a value in a closure or something more; one protocol or two; many engines on one store; storage's swap per backend; eviction and segments; peers and several predecessors; the act cut short with engines many; read and change as the slicing; what holds a buffer.

name: What the eleventh session leaves open

body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken, the session's reading which, including those he sent while the session worked; typing slips and words the dictation misheard marked on the word, with what was written kept. After each, the essence of the session's answer in its own voice, drafted in parts and each part read against the original by a blank agent, every omission, distortion and addition found mended. The work stands in bf48cf7, Glass, as designed; c3858db and 9e952ab, the engine designed and settled; 75801ca, the oracle; d4656e2 to d5ae92d, the engine written anew and put in place; 6dd6cd5, its simplification; and in the knowledge space written at its end, Glass: one field of holons, kept by stores, governed by engines. It began on 2026-11-11 and ran into 2026-11-12, a compaction between.

name: An eleventh session, kept whole: the engine written anew, and drawn again as journeys over a held field
